name: Al Muqeet
description: Allah sustains His creatures and supplies their nourishment. Al Muqeet also conveys power and watchfulness over all things.
summary: Al Muqeet is explained in terms of supplying nourishment and sustaining creation, and also in terms of power and watchfulness. Quran 4:85 uses the name in a passage about responsibility for intercession. Its root is q-w-t (ق و ت); provision overlaps with Ar Razzaaq rather than forming an entirely separate attribute.
